title: Feature request: Units left to inject while bolusing
symptom: When a bolus injection has started, the same info is given twice on the same window: the total of units to be injected. It would be nice if the upper part gave the total of U to be injected and the lower part indicated the units left to inject.
fix: The feature was implemented in the dev branch: the upper part shows the total units, and the lower part shows the injected units (not the units left). The issue was closed after this implementation.
evidence_quote: See screenshot of my dev phone (dev branch), it will be close to your proposal (Total in the upper part, not the unit left in the lower part but the injected Units)
